CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2745 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head fb7683af246ccc5c23ebe5229e9447d58708207e. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch fb7683af246ccc5c23ebe5229e9447d58708207e for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-sav-comfort-r2, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-sav-comfort-r2 <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-sav-comfort-r2; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Continue from handoff/r10-sav-comfort (tip fb7683af246ccc5c23ebe5229e9447d58708207e); do not restart from main. update_pr (merging origin/main eceef457a into it) was REFUSED by prepr:
(1) tests / mutation ADDED UNPINNED sites: optimizer.py:324 RETURN_DEL, :333 GUARD_OFF, :336 RETURN_DEL, :5294 BOOLOP and GUARD_OFF, :5335 CLAMP_DROP. The body's `## Unpinned sites` omits them. Pin each with a killing test (mutation_table.py --pin-killed) or kill the site, or triage it there; null control for each.
(2) pr-contract CARRY UNROUTED for the body items "Carry 5, seam 2: actuate the supply switch at step boundaries ..." and the Friction line "dispatch-return-ref: contradiction: PROMPT.md's Output line names ...". carry_audit reads main's roster; a carry to a group must be a group open on main's roster (or, once R10-FLOW-ROSTER-FREEZE arm (b) lands, on the round ref). Route each to an open group, or mark a Friction line dismissed with its reason; read tools/audit/carry_audit.py for what routes.
(3) Claim files: after merging main, `git diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)...HEAD -- tests/golden/claimed_drift.txt tests/golden/card_claimed_drift.txt` must add only this branch's own claims (claims-for equal to VERSION 7.0.4). The handoff currently DELETES main's five R10-SCORES lines (coord_all_features, coord_dhw, coord_grid_fee, coord_minimal, coord_two_zone); a branch must not rewrite main's claims (claim-files.md). Restore them verbatim and keep your own, so env_drift.py reads no stale claim and no unclaimed drift.
Re-run prepr to a pass, then push handoff/r10-sav-comfort (new 40-hex tip) and handoff-body/r10-sav-comfort per the fixer contract. Re-take the whole body.
no host or home paths in anything you push
